steps.say: In a speaking test, an examiner asks you questions. You answer out loud.
Listen to the whole question. Then answer it.
Answer with a full sentence if you can. I can see a cat is better than cat.
If you do not know a word, say something near it, and keep talking.
Speak clearly and not too fast. Take a breath at the end of a sentence.

check.prompt: The examiner asks: What can you see? Which answer is best?
hints: Think about what helps you most.
Look back at the steps in this lesson.
Try each choice. Which one makes sense?
check.explanation: A full sentence with the right words is best.

options.text: I can see a cat and a dog.

check.prompt: I ___ see a cat in the picture.
hints: Look back at the steps in this lesson.
Write one word in the gap.
